rationale: Draftsperson path at a Bendigo structural and civil consultancy that welcomes people just starting out; tertiary qualification preferred but not required, and Marc holds an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design plus a BSCE.
Office uses AutoCAD and Civil 3D, which Marc prepared drawings in during his Advanced Diploma (road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater).
Regional Victoria location suits Marc's recorded availability for regional work from Melton with licence and transport.
caution: CAD experience is academic rather than commercial production. Role can also be filled as a structural engineer; Marc is applying on the draftsperson path. Solid CAD proficiency is essential.
gaps: No paid Australian office experience yet
apply_instructions: Apply via SEEK job 95099349 (Private Advertiser listing for SGP Consulting Engineers, Bendigo). Early submission encouraged; applications reviewed on a rolling basis.
title: Structural Engineer or Draftsperson
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a structural engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you completed a qualification in civil engineering?
employer_line: SGP Consulting Engineers is a Bendigo based structural and civil practice working across Victoria and southern NSW on commercial and residential projects, using AutoCAD and Civil 3D in the office.
